review_method: Full-domain structural/pattern screening with prioritized bilingual review and original bytecode context checks.

root.scope: dlc, factions, non-background entity prose and supplemental UI
root.method: Compared Chinese with English for the queued descriptions, settlement rumors, labels and fragments. Checked getDescription concatenation in the official rebuilding_effort_situation bytecode. Name-policy entries were checked using effective display translations, not obsolete hidden drafts.
root.limits: No live game or full narrative playthrough. Structural and effective-display scans do not prove all semantics correct.

contracts.scope: full_catalog.entries with at least one scripts/contracts/ or scripts/ambitions/ context
methods: Read every source/translation pair with source length <=180, covering short tasks, titles, options and dynamic fragments; re-read omitted output slices to close truncation gaps.
Read every source/translation pair with source length 181-499, covering ambition prerequisites, arena rules, narrative outcomes, negotiation variants and religious-war descriptions.

Scanned every selected entry for placeholder multiplicity, formatting tags, images, branch-delimiter topology, untranslated Latin prose, and high-risk phrasing such as Secure/确保; manually examined reported exceptions.

Read official data_001.dat Cnut function literals to establish concatenation order for camp direction, sacrifice injury count, tutorial recruits, defending settlements, barbarian revenge, and envoy escort/wait.
Generated sample complete strings and checked them against explicitly authored expected Chinese, including both injury-count grammatical branches and both defense-result branches.
Rechecked Direction8 variable producer and scripts/config/strings.cnut values (north=北, south=南, east=东, west=西, north-east=东北); location suffixes use 方 for all eight directions, avoiding 南方向.

exception_decisions.decision: Keep current translation markers. Full paired reading shows source has incorrect speech open/close markers; translation repairs dialogue/narration boundaries. Mechanical marker-count equality would restore original bugs.

The Oracle Latin residue is an intentional place-name mention requiring final build/runtime handling. reviewed_place_names maps it to 神谕院; place_name_mentions records this key. No direct replacement proposed.
Official negotiation template uses Payment.MaxCount after up to, confirming this is a maximum number of heads, not a maximum crowns amount. Retain current number semantics.

boundaries: 570 source entries of length >=500 were structurally/keyword scanned but not fully read line-by-line; do not present this report as complete sentence-level proof of all long narrative branches.
Concatenation order evidence is static official Cnut literals and catalog context, with authored substitutions; no game launched and no visual/in-game event-branch acceptance performed.
No main catalog, reviewed override files, game installation, release, or third-party translation was modified or inspected as translation evidence.
Sample city names, personal names, and counts are illustrative test substitutions, not claims about a particular save.

gameplay.scope: skills/items/retinue/ui/states/ai/config，非人地名；仅生成建议，不修改共享词库。
gameplay.source: app/localization/full_catalog.json；有歧义的组合读取本机官方Steam原版cnut，不参考第三方汉化。
gameplay.empty_translations_explanation: 7条均明确标记omit_grammar，分别为英语冠词或复数词尾，中文有意留空，无新增漏译。

validation.note: 使用项目原有校验器，未修改校验规则；349f2d58957b9a857a32保留2%数字格式。

method: 全范围枚举分类、上下文、译文完整性；按功能阅读UI、状态、日志、提示和装备描述。
重点追踪英语多义词、指向错误、宾语放在动词后的动态句式、共享前后缀，以及技能/装备名的引用一致性。
官方字节码核实convert_order聚落转化、shield与weapon数值拼接、坚守之誓共享片段、staggered/dazed日志顺序、gores日志无目标参数。
所有建议比较before/after，确认数字、百分号变量、完整标签、HTML和随机分支符号不变；生成9个拼接样例并断言预期文本。
manual_coverage: AI 21条；retinue 100条；config每日提示116条，完整阅读。
UI选项、工具提示、菜单与动态片段，以及states短文本；按批阅读覆盖全部清单，但少数大批输出发生截断，不作逐句签收。
skills短于180字符条目1643条按批审查；长背景和技能长文以疑似术语及语义问题进行定向核对。
items含标签、动态首尾空白或长于180字符的238条重点审查；40至180字符的普通描述598条按批阅读，部分大批输出截断。
config strings中的属性、专长和机制说明按语境核对，部分字符串为已由reviewed_place_names覆盖的地名，主动排除；家族箴言与背景段落抽样核对。
limitations: 这是全范围结构/风险筛查加重点语言审校，不声称每条长剧情、所有人地名和所有随机分支都已人工逐句审定。
尚未逐句审完所有长技能背景、势力传闻、家族背景及纯装备名称，不能保证不存在余下语义问题。
未启动游戏，未验证实际字体、控件宽度或场景触发；原版全量构建和共享验证由主代理执行。
地名以最终reviewed_place_names生效覆盖为准，未把旧full_catalog中已被覆盖的地名误报为运行时问题。
excluded_changes: has dazed日志保留原译；共享for片段不修改，兼容志向系统。
未改角色名、地名、占位符、标签、变量计算或运行时代码。

narrative.scope: Entries with at least one official source context in /events/, /scenarios/ or /backgrounds/. Background entries are actually under scripts/skills/backgrounds/. Shared entries count once.
narrative.source_provenance: Read official English source/translation/contexts embedded in app/localization/full_catalog.json. Price effects additionally checked against local Steam official data_001.dat bytecode, matching catalog SHA-256. No third-party translations used.
methods: Full scope keyword/context scan for machine-literal wording, administrative register, modern terms, weak dynamic phrasing, and selected grammatical constructions. Matches are leads, not automatic replacements.
Manually read all 2491 English source/Chinese translation pairs under 100 English characters, including names, options, headings, mood reasons and fragments.
Manually read all scenario entries and all 133 medium-length background pairs; selectively read long narratives implicated by flags or fragment contexts.
Inspect contexts of reusable prefixes/suffixes before proposing paired word-order changes; leave shared fragments unchanged when other callers need their existing structure.
Validate that proposed before/after translations retain identical placeholder, markup, branch delimiter and numeric-token multisets; validate composed examples.

Verify official scenario onInit bytecode sets Beast Slayers BuyPriceMult=1.1/SellPriceMult=0.9 and Trading Caravan BuyPriceMult=0.9/SellPriceMult=1.1; evidence retained in narrative-price-evidence.json.

keyword_screen.disposition: All 46 flagged entries inspected in Chinese excerpts. Only targeted candidates subsequently read in full source/translation context; valid occurrences of words such as 确保/执行 were retained.

narrative.coverage_limit: This pass is a complete automated screen of the assigned domain, plus the specified complete short/scenario/background-medium reads. It is not a claim of line-by-line reading of all 1091 long entries (many contain multiple long randomized branches). Long unflagged prose remains outside close review in this pass.
narrative.delivery: Proposals only. The full catalog, shared source dictionaries, game files and installed packages were not modified. No game launch, install or release performed.

changes.source:
Morale is one of five states and represents the mental condition of combatants and their effectiveness in battle. At the lowest state, fleeing, a character will be outside your control - although they may eventually rally again. Morale changes as the battle unfolds, with characters that have high resolve less likely to fall to low morale states. Many of your opponents are affected by morale as well.

Morale checks trigger on these occasions:
- Killing an enemy
- Seeing an enemy be killed
- Seeing an ally be killed
- Seeing an ally flee
- Being hit for 15 or more damage to hitpoints
- Being engaged by more than one opponent
- Using certain skills, like 'Rally'

- 目睹友军溃逃
- 一次攻击损失15点或更多生命值
- 同时与多名敌人接战
- 使用特定技能，例如“重振士气”

changes.source: Unlocks the 'Rally' skill which can rally fleeing allies, and raise morale of all nearby allies to a steady level. The higher the Resolve of the character using the skill, the higher the chance to succeed.
changes.before: 解锁“重振士气”技能，可以鼓舞溃逃的友军，并将附近友军的士气提升至“镇定”。施放者的意志越高，成功率越高。
changes.after: 解锁“鼓舞”技能，可以使溃逃的友军重返战斗，并将附近友军的士气提升至“镇定”。施放者的意志越高，成功率越高。
changes.reason: 引用Rally主动技能名称，与实际技能鼓舞保持一致，同时区分重振溃逃者与提高士气两种效果。

changes.source: Unlocks the 'Taunt' skill which makes the targeted opponent take offensive actions instead of defensive ones, and attack the taunting character over another, potentially more vulnerable one.
changes.before: 解锁“嘲讽”技能，迫使目标采取攻势而非防守，转而攻击嘲讽者，放过其他可能更脆弱的目标。
changes.after: 解锁“挑衅”技能，迫使目标采取攻势而非防守，转而攻击挑衅者，放过其他可能更脆弱的目标。
changes.reason: 引用Taunt主动技能，实际技能名称为挑衅，原译嘲讽造成名称不一致。

changes.source: Unlocks the 'Debilitate' skill which can prime your next attack to cripple a target for one turn, reducing their ability to inflict damage by [color=
changes.before: 解锁“削弱打击”技能，使下一次攻击命中后削弱目标一回合，赋予其伤害修正：[color=
changes.after: 解锁“削弱”技能，使下一次攻击命中后削弱目标一回合，赋予其伤害修正：[color=
changes.reason: Debilitate主动技能名为削弱；削弱打击是效果名称。此处解锁的是技能。

changes.source: ]20%[/color] damage against targets that have sustained any injury effects, like a broken arm.
changes.before: ]20%[/color]伤害，仅对已经带有断臂等伤势的目标生效。
changes.after: ]20%[/color]伤害，仅对已经带有手臂骨折等伤势的目标生效。
changes.reason: broken arm是手臂骨折，并非失去手臂；与具体伤势名一致。
Spetum物品的实际名称为三尖矛。此处说明该武器的矛术精通收益，避免玩家无法对应装备。

changes.source: Fulfilling ambitions will raise everyone's mood and grant you renown, as well as some unique rewards.
changes.before: 实现抱负能改善全团心情、提升声望，还可能获得独特奖励。
changes.after: 完成战团志向能改善全团心情、提升声望，还可能获得独特奖励。
changes.reason: Ambitions明确指志向系统，统一为战团志向；声望/名望全库协调由主审另行处理，本轮保留此处既有声望。
Corpse指尸骸，血肉之躯本身不表达死亡，误导可复生尸体名称。
日志顺序为施放者+片段+目标，原译将目标向后抛出：生硬。改后组成施放者向后抛飞了目标。
原版onTeleportDone日志只拼接施放者与gores，不接目标；改后形成完整行动叙述。
巨蛇技能日志为施放者+片段+目标；拖入缺少去处，拖近了能自然表达将目标拖到身边。

changes.source: ]+5[/color] Defense against all attacks for each ally adjacent also using Shieldwall
changes.before: ]+5[/color]全类防御，每名相邻且同样使用盾墙的友军分别提供一次加成
changes.after: ]+5[/color]近战与远程防御，每名相邻且同样使用盾墙的友军分别提供一次加成
changes.reason: against all attacks指两类攻击防御，不是游戏中不存在的全类防御属性。
原版按施放者+has staggered+目标+持续时间拼接；原译使其踉跄后再接目标语序错误。保留踉跄状态术语，使用与恍惚日志一致的提示格式。

changes.source: This character's flesh is reforming and they are temporarily incapacitated for [color=
changes.before: 此角色的血肉正在重新成形，暂时无法行动。效果还将持续[color=
changes.after: 此角色的血肉正在重新成形。效果还将持续[color=
changes.reason: 后续共享片段已包含在此期间无法行动，移除同一句提示中重复的无法行动。

changes.source: Always able to successfully escape from ensnaring effects, such as from nets or roots
changes.before: 挣脱渔网、根须等缠绕效果时必定成功
changes.after: 挣脱捕网、根须等束缚时必定成功
changes.reason: net对应战斗物品捕网，不是捕鱼用的渔网；同时让挣脱对象表述自然。

changes.before: 盾牌技能的额外疲劳消耗：[color=
changes.after: 盾牌技能疲劳消耗修正：[color=
changes.reason: 官方shield.getTooltip直接拼接带正负号的疲劳消耗修正值，本片段还被坚守之誓25%减免共用；额外疲劳消耗不能正确覆盖减免语境。

changes.before: 武器技能的额外疲劳消耗：[color=
changes.after: 武器技能疲劳消耗修正：[color=
changes.reason: 官方weapon.getTooltip直接拼接带正负号的疲劳消耗修正值，用修正替代只暗示增加的额外。
与盾牌技能疲劳消耗修正前缀拼成盾牌技能疲劳消耗修正：25%减免，移除重复的疲劳消耗。
与主审统一的Chance to Hit Head属性名一致。
与物品提示及主审补充UI统一的Chance to Hit Head属性名一致。

changes.source: Provisions. Dried Lamb is a speciality and a highy sought-after food in the south. A real treat for any hungry mercenary.
changes.before: 口粮。南方广受欢迎的特色食物，对饥肠辘辘的佣兵来说，是难得的美味。
changes.after: 口粮。风干羊肉是南方广受欢迎的特色食物，对饥肠辘辘的佣兵来说，是难得的美味。
changes.reason: 补回原文Dried Lamb的食物种类，名称与对应物品风干羊肉一致。

changes.source: A drinking cup made from massive gold. Should be worth a lot if you can find a buyer.
changes.before: 一只实心金杯。找到合适的买家，应该能卖个好价钱。
changes.after: 一只纯金酒杯。找到合适的买家，应该能卖个好价钱。
changes.reason: massive gold指纯金材质，实心金杯会被理解为杯体内部没有容积。

changes.source: An exquisitely crafted curved blade, notoriously used by assassins of the southern deserts. Particularly effective against targets already debilitated.
changes.before: 一柄精制弯刃匕首，因南方沙漠刺客的使用而恶名远扬。对已经陷入虚弱状态的目标格外有效。
changes.after: 一柄精制弯刃匕首，因南方沙漠刺客的使用而恶名远扬。对已受制的目标格外有效。
changes.reason: Qatal匕首的Deathblow加成针对眩晕、恍惚或被捕网束缚的目标；此处debilitated是一般描述，原译虚弱状态易被误认成指定状态。

changes.source: A curved blade notoriously used by assassins of the southern deserts. Particularly effective against targets already debilitated.
changes.before: 一柄弯刃匕首，因南方沙漠刺客的使用而恶名远扬。对已经陷入虚弱状态的目标格外有效。
changes.after: 一柄弯刃匕首，因南方沙漠刺客的使用而恶名远扬。对已受制的目标格外有效。
changes.reason: Qatal匕首的Deathblow加成针对眩晕、恍惚或被捕网束缚的目标；此处debilitated是一般描述，原译虚弱状态易被误认成指定状态。
学习事件的结果后接教师姓名；用完整中文谓语替代“得到指点，师从”的重复表述。
与 something 片段成组修改：教了＋姓名＋一些本领，避免“已经教会某人某样东西”。
与 Has taught 前缀成组修改；此处是传授本领，而非交付某样东西。
与 a favor 后缀成组修改：拒绝了＋姓名＋的请求。
“Denied 某人 a favor”在求助情境下意为拒绝对方的请求，不是“拒绝某人一个人情”。
与 some 后缀成组重排：对＋姓名＋渐生好感，修复“逐渐喜欢上某人一些”。
与 Grew to like 前缀成组重排，保留好感有所增加的含义。
与 anything 后缀成组修改：没能教会＋姓名＋任何本事。
此处是教学失败的结果，anything 指学会的本领，“没能教好某人任何东西”搭配错误。
与 antics 后缀成组重排：因＋姓名＋的胡闹而恼火，删除多余代词与冒号。
与 Annoyed by 前缀成组修改为自然的因果句。
与 preaching 后缀成组重排：受到＋姓名＋的布道鼓舞。
与 Encouraged by 前缀成组重排，避免“受到鼓舞，缘于某人的布道”的倒装。
与 dying sun 后缀成组修改，让“享受某人关于太阳将死的言论”读起来自然。
与 Relished 前缀成组修改，保留欣然听对方讲话的含义。

changes.source: %monk%, you speak for the old gods. What say you?
changes.before: %monk%，你替旧神传言。这事你怎么看？
changes.after: %monk%，你传达旧神的旨意。这事你怎么看？
changes.reason: speak for 在这里指代表神明发言；“替旧神传言”容易被理解为散播传闻。
On the road 是事件发生场景的标题，并非让玩家继续赶路的行动选项。
传记片段后接城镇及“并在那里主动请求做你的侍从”；改用人物作主语，同时修复原译主语误落在“你”上及“以下地方”的生硬表达。
人物小传后接具体城镇，不应使用清单式的“你在以下地方找到了……”。

changes.source: You found %name% on the streets of
changes.before: 你在以下地方的街头找到了%name%：
changes.reason: 与后续火焰杂耍片段成组重排，将“的街头”移至城镇名之后，保持自然中文语序。

changes.source: Like peas in a pod. Or pigs in a pen?
changes.before: 亲如同荚的豆子。还是同圈的猪？
changes.after: 这俩还真是一路人。像同荚的豆子，还是同圈的猪？
changes.reason: 保留豆荚与猪圈的揶揄意象，同时把英语习语换成读者能直接理解的中文。
赌徒绰号 Deuces 指二点牌或骰子上的二点，幺为一点；纠正点数含义。

changes.source: The only thing swift about a cripple is his expected demise in a real battle.
changes.before: 残疾人唯一迅速的，恐怕就是他在真正战斗中丧命的速度。
changes.after: 残疾人真上了战场，恐怕也只有送命比别人快。
changes.reason: 保留原文的黑色幽默，修复“唯一迅速的……速度”的英语式名词搭配。

changes.source: Beast Slayers are used to expertly hunt monstrous beasts at all ranges.
changes.before: 猎兽人擅长在各种距离下猎杀凶兽。
changes.after: 猎兽者无论远攻近战，都善于猎杀凶兽。
changes.reason: 属性说明使用与职业标题一致的“猎兽者”，并将 at all ranges 改成自然的远近作战描述。

changes.source: Brawlers are unmatched in unarmed combat, and physical exercise tends to leave them in good shape.
changes.before: 拳师精于徒手格斗，长期锻炼也让他们身体强健。
changes.after: 拳斗者精于徒手格斗，长期锻炼也让他们身体强健。
changes.reason: 职业属性说明中的主体与 Brawler 背景标题“拳斗者”保持一致。

changes.source: Disowned nobles often have profited from some training in melee fighting at court.
changes.before: 失势贵族往往在宫廷中受过一些近战训练。
changes.after: 被逐贵族往往在宫廷中受过一些近战训练。
changes.reason: 职业属性说明中的主体与 Disowned Noble 背景标题“被逐贵族”保持一致。

changes.source: Graverobbers are not faint of heart.
changes.reason: 职业属性说明中的主体与 Graverobber 背景标题“盗墓贼”保持一致。

changes.source: Historians are studious individuals with vast amounts of knowledge, none of it any use on the battlefield.
changes.before: 历史学家勤学博闻，可惜满腹学问在战场上都派不上用场。
changes.after: 历史学者勤学博闻，可惜满腹学问在战场上都派不上用场。
changes.reason: 职业属性说明中的主体与 Historian 背景标题“历史学者”保持一致。

changes.source: A miller is used to physical labor.
changes.reason: 职业属性说明中的主体与 Miller 背景标题“磨坊主”保持一致；不机械改写叙事称谓。

changes.source: Squires usually have received some training in warfare, and often have a high resolve to excel in what they do.
changes.before: 扈从通常受过军事训练，也有很强的上进心。
changes.after: 骑士侍从通常受过军事训练，也有很强的上进心。
changes.reason: 职业属性说明中的主体与 Squire 背景标题“骑士侍从”保持一致。

changes.source: Wildmen are used to the hard life of the wild where only the strong prevail. They are less used to the life of cities, where the astute and deceitful rule.
changes.before: 野人习惯荒野的艰苦生活，那里只有强者能够生存。他们却不适应城市，那里是精明者和骗子的天下。
changes.after: 荒野人习惯荒野的艰苦生活，那里只有强者能够生存。他们却不适应城市，那里是精明者和骗子的天下。
changes.reason: 职业属性说明中的主体与 Wildman 背景标题“荒野人”保持一致。

changes.source: A miner will be used to physical labor, but breathing in the dusty air of the mines may have taken a toll on his health over the years.
changes.before: 矿工做惯了体力活，但多年吸入矿井里的粉尘，可能已损害了他们的身体。
changes.after: 矿工做惯了体力活，但常年呼吸矿井里满是粉尘的空气，可能已损害了他们的健康。
changes.reason: 将 dusty air 译为满是粉尘的空气，health 明确为健康，并调整长定语使职业说明更流畅。

changes.source: A swordmaster excels in melee combat like no other, but may be vulnerable at range. Age may have taken a toll on his physical attributes and may continue to do so.
changes.before: 剑术大师的近战技艺无人能及，却可能容易遭到远程攻击。年龄也许已开始侵蚀他的体能，并且还会继续。
changes.after: 剑术大师的近战技艺无人能及，却可能不善于抵御远程攻击。岁月也许已开始削弱他的体能，而且还会继续。
changes.reason: vulnerable at range 指远程防御较弱，并非更容易成为远程攻击的目标；同时避免“可能容易”的叠加。

changes.source: , ready to put on fiery display of record-breaking fire juggling that could have well cost him his life. Luckily,

changes.after: 的街头，当时他正要表演一场打破纪录的火焰杂耍，弄不好就会送命。幸好，
changes.reason: 与 You found %name% on the streets of 前缀成组修改，将地点定语放在动态城镇名之后。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{As the men bandy back and forth making shadows, %killer%, the alleged killer on the run, walks up to the camp carrying armfuls of jewelry and other goods, their metals glistening with crimson sheens. He's murmuring to himself, but then suddenly stops and look at the rest of the company.%SPEECH_ON%Oh. You guys are still awake? I was just, uh, out. Doing things.%SPEECH_OFF%There's blood on his face and caked under his fingernails. Sensing himself in trouble, he drops the goods.%SPEECH_ON%These are for the company, of course. I'm just so, uh, thankful that you all took me in. Thought I'd repay the favor, you know?%SPEECH_OFF%The men stare at the goods. You ask the man if someone is going to come looking for those items. He grins.%SPEECH_ON%No sir, of course not. I made sure of it. Oh captain, did I make sure of it, heh, heh, heh.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell the man to put the goods into inventory, but to be sure to clean them up first. As he walks away, the rest of the men quietly exchange glances. There's no more shadow games left to play, it seems.}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_51.png[/img]{弟兄们正你来我往地摆弄影子，据说是逃亡凶犯的%killer%回到了营地，怀里抱满珠宝和各种物件，金属表面泛着猩红的光。他低声嘟囔着，忽然停下脚步，看向其他人。%SPEECH_ON%噢。你们还没睡？我只是，呃，出去了一趟。办点事。%SPEECH_OFF%他脸上沾着血，指甲缝里也结着血垢。察觉到气氛不对，他连忙放下怀里的东西。%SPEECH_ON%这些当然都是给战团的。我只是，呃，特别感激你们肯收留我。想着回报一下，明白吧？%SPEECH_OFF%弟兄们盯着那些东西。你问他，会不会有人来找这些失物。他咧开嘴笑了。%SPEECH_ON%不会，长官，当然不会。我已经确保万无一失了。噢，团长，我可是好好地确保了一番，嘿，嘿，嘿。%SPEECH_OFF%你让他把东西收进库存，但务必先擦干净。他走开后，其余人默默交换着眼神。看来，没人再有兴致玩影子游戏了。}

changes.reason: 持械威慑旁观者的情境应直述阻止抗议，“确保抗议得不过分”语气与搭配均生硬。

changes.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_122.png[/img][/p][p]You and your men make your living by hunting down the many beasts that beset villages on the fringes of civilization. It's dangerous work, but it pays well enough, and there's always a bigger beast to slay and more crowns to earn.

[color=#bcad8c]Beast Slayers:[/color] Start with three beast slayers and decent equipment, as well as some beast trophies.
[color=#bcad8c]Expert Trackers:[/color] See tracks from further away.
[color=#bcad8c]Expert Skinners:[/color] Each beast you slay has a 50% chance to drop an additional trophy.
[color=#bcad8c]Prejudice:[/color] Most people don't trust your kind, so you get 10% worse prices.[/p]
changes.before:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_122.png[/img][/p][p]在文明边缘，村庄时常遭到野兽侵扰。你和手下靠猎杀这些猛兽谋生。这行当虽险，报酬倒也不差。总有更凶猛的猎物等着你们，也总有更多克朗可以赚。

[color=#bcad8c]猎兽者：[/color]开局拥有三名猎兽者、不错的装备和一些野兽战利品。
[color=#bcad8c]追踪高手：[/color]能够发现更远处的足迹。
[color=#bcad8c]剥皮能手：[/color]每只被击杀的野兽都有 50% 的概率额外掉落一份战利品。
[color=#bcad8c]世俗偏见：[/color]多数人不信任你们，买卖价格因此不利 10%。[/p]

changes.source:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img][/p][p]You're running a small trade caravan and have most of your crowns invested into trading goods. But the roads have become dangerous - brigands and greenskins lay in ambush, and there's rumors of even worse things out there.

[color=#bcad8c]Caravan:[/color] Start with two caravan hands in your employ.
[color=#bcad8c]Trader:[/color] Get 10% better prices for buying and selling.
[color=#bcad8c]Not a Warrior:[/color] Start with no renown, and gain renown at only 66% the normal rate.[/p]
changes.before:
[p=c][img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img][/p][p]你经营着一支小商队，大部分积蓄都换成了货物。可商路越来越不太平：强盗与绿皮四处设伏，传闻还有更可怕的东西潜藏在荒野。

[color=#bcad8c]商队：[/color]开局雇有两名商队伙计。
[color=#bcad8c]精于买卖：[/color]买入和卖出商品的价格均有利 10%。
[color=#bcad8c]经商之人：[/color]开局没有声望，之后获得声望的速度只有正常的 66%。[/p]
